title: Settlement Type
description:
When using this oracle to reveal the scale and purpose of a settlement, choose whether the community is located in settled lands, boundary lands, or remote lands. If unsure, set the location based on the region:

✴ Settled lands: Havens
✴ Boundary lands: Barrier Islands, Flooded Lands, Hinterlands, Ragged Coast
✴ Remote lands: Deep Wilds, Tempest Hills, Veiled Mountains

data.value: Stead — Tiny, self-sustaining settlement with a few family dwellings
Camp — Temporary settlement for nomadic people, soldiers, or seasonal workers
Outpost — Border or frontier settlement for defense, trade, or exploration
Hamlet — Small settlement with a few homes, limited services, and informal leadership
Village — Moderate-sized settlement with communal buildings and recognized leadership
Hold — Large, fortified settlement with diverse trade skills and well-established leadership
